source_role: compatibility review packet for the unresolved Vanadium benchmark row

field_review.review_note: The primary APS harvest PDF confirms Tc = 5.03 K. This conflicts with the current working row value 5.36 K, so the row cannot be called source-locked until a full coherent row patch is reviewed.
The primary APS harvest PDF confirms the normal-state fit value Theta = 338 +/- 5 K. This differs materially from the working row value 380 K and must be reviewed as part of a coherent row patch.

The open-fulltext Eliashberg capture is explicit, but it does not support the older internal candidate near 0.6 and does not match the current working row either. This field now requires convention review rather than blind substitution.
External captures point to higher mu-star conventions than the retained working value 0.11. A convention decision is required before the Vanadium row can enter patch review.

next_decisions: Use the primary-page-confirmed Tc=5.03 K and Theta=338+/-5 K values as the active evidence for any future Vanadium row patch review.
Decide whether the open-fulltext Eliashberg lambda and mu-star values are compatible with the benchmark row's intended convention.
Do not apply the older internal lambda=0.6 patch preview unless a source family clearly supports it.
claim_boundary: This packet is a compatibility review aid only. It does not approve any topic-local row patch.
